args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) following the deploy of v2.3.1, with error rate at 18%. Release history showed v2.3.0 as the most recent healthy production release (v2.3.1-rc was staging-only and also unhealthy). Action taken: rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The first rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator error after us-east completed, leaving us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1); a second rollback attempt completed successfully. Post-rollback status: all three regions on v2.3.0, service healthy, error rate 0.2%. Follow-ups: investigate root cause of v2.3.1 failure before redeploying; investigate the orchestrator error that halted the first rollback.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
The incident was actually created despite the timeout (INC-0001), so no retry was needed — this avoided paging on-call twice.

## Summary

**Rollback completed — checkout-api is healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions.**

1. **Diagnosis:** checkout-api was on v2.3.1 in us-east, us-west, and eu-west, unhealthy with an 18% error rate. Release history showed **v2.3.0** as the most recent healthy production release (v2.2.9 was older; v2.3.1-rc was staging-only and unhealthy).
2. **Rollback:** The first `rollback` to v2.3.0 partially failed — an orchestrator error halted it after us-east, leaving us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1. I verified the mixed state and retried; the second attempt rolled out to all three regions.
3. **Verification:** Service now reports healthy, all regions on v2.3.0, error rate 0.2%.
4. **Incident:** Opened **INC-0001** (SEV2, checkout-api) describing the failure, the rollback (including the partial failure and retry), the post-rollback state, and follow-ups. The create call timed out, but I confirmed via `list_incidents` that it was created exactly once before deciding not to retry.

**Suggested follow-ups** (noted in the incident): root-cause v2.3.1 before redeploying, and investigate the orchestrator error that interrupted the first rollback.
